package.name: armor_perception
package.description: RoboMaster armor-plate perception for a UAV observing a static plate. Reuses the stateless detection core of sp_vision_25 (light-bar detector, armor geometry, digit classifier) and replaces its gimbal-oriented solver and state estimator with a world-frame, translation-aware pipeline driven by VIO odometry. Non-contact: reports target pose and an observation point only, never flight commands.
